Qix npm Phishing Package Compromise

Campaign: qix-npm-phishing-2025
Date: 2025-09-08
Actor: Third Party (group)
Impact: financial_exploitation

Synopsis

The Qix npm phishing campaign turned a single maintainer account compromise into a burst of poisoned JavaScript utility releases on September 8, 2025. Attackers used a fake npm login flow to seize publishing access, then pushed malicious versions of tiny but heavily depended-on packages such as debug, chalk, ansi-regex, strip-ansi, and wrap-ansi. The payload hid inside frontend bundles, intercepted wallet and network APIs, and rewrote cryptocurrency transactions before users signed them.
